rightSection.heading: Beware of common AI mistakes in this task:

failureModes.title: Demand proof for 'impossible.':
failureModes.description: If the AI says a full schedule cannot work, ask for the exact conflicting constraint or a complete failed schedule.

failureModes.title: Separate availability from preferences.:
failureModes.description: Check whether the AI confuses “can work all days,” “wants two shifts,” and “is already assigned.”

failureModes.title: Verify counts with a table.:
failureModes.description: Before trusting statements like “five assistants,” list each person and mark days explicitly.

failureModes.title: missing global constraints
failureModes.description: when focusing one part of the task instead of checking whether all conditions work together.

failureModes.title: missing hard impossibilities
failureModes.description: when overlooking facts that make a claim impossible, such as unavailable people or rule conflicts.

failureModes.title: using heuristic reasoning instead of task logic
failureModes.description: when concluding 'it’s probably true' without actually considering task constraints.
